decision_premium: close_T / estimated NAV_T - 1; estimated NAV_T = latest NAV dated at least two mainland trading days before T, moved by the US ETF (SPY/QQQ) from that NAV date to the last US close before date T; ignores RMB moves and fees
after_the_fact_premium: close_T / NAV of the previous NAV date - 1 (description only)

forward_check.measure: ETF return minus NAV return over the horizon (the premium change paid back)

gate.contribution: 1 unit on the first mainland trading day of each month
gate.waiting: pending money earns 2% and is fully invested on the first day the decision premium <= threshold
gate.cap_variant: pending money is invested anyway after 60 trading days
